Subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate follow-up

Thanks again for the call earlier, Alex — great to learn more about the Acme Health pilot and how you're validating summaries across provider notes. Quick recap and follow-ups from our side: 

- Current pilot scope: summarization for 6k daily notes, ~=120k tokens/day (you mentioned spikes up to 180k/day on heavy days).
- Projected run-rate: ~3.6M tokens/month at current usage; if you expand to the full cohort you estimated ~8–10M tokens/month.
- Unit economics you shared: target $/1M tokens in the ballpark of $350–$450.
- Success criteria: 90% clinician acceptance on summaries + <1.5s mean token latency for the UI prototypes.

Action items / asks:
1) Can you confirm the baseline monthly token target (3.6M vs 8–10M) so we size credits appropriately?
2) What budget range is approved for a production pilot (monthly)? you mentioned an internal target of ~$1,200–$3,000 / month but I want to confirm.
3) We can offer a short credits extension so you can complete the end-to-end evaluation (longer session logging). Would 2 weeks be sufficient, or do you need longer?

Narrowing on the unit economics: to hit your $/1M target of ~$350–$450 we recommend using Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantized model + batching). If you can share a 24–48h slice of production traffic we can run a quick cost estimate and recommend a target tokens-to-$ mapping.

I've attached the pilot_usage_report.csv and our MVP_pricing_sheet.pdf for reference. If you confirm the numbers above I can request an internal credits approval and come back with an exact amount (we typically start with 50k–100k tokens of complimentary credit for pilots of this size).

Next step: would you be open to a 30-minute check-in next Wed (Jul 7) to go over the usage estimates and target $/1M?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: pilot_usage_report.csv, MVP_pricing_sheet.pdf

- Budget: leadership has signaled ~$2k/month to start (so within your $350–$450 / 1M target, we need to confirm exact assignment from finance).

Two asks from us:

2) Can you confirm that the credits will cover hosting on your hosted API (not private deployment) and allow us to run the quantized model variant?

On timing, Wed Jul 7 works for a 30-min check-in — Priya (cc'd) will confirm calendar invite.
